technology_name: Molecular Tools for Authentication of Plant Varieties
institution: KSCSTE- Jawaharlal Nehru Tropical Botanic Garden & Research Institute (JNTBGRI)
problem_solved: The unreliability of visual plant identification caused by environmental changes, and the rampant agricultural fraud involving genetically impure or mislabeled commercial seeds.
description: A high-precision DNA fingerprinting and genotyping service for plant varietal identification. The methodology utilizes advanced molecular marker technologies—including Simple Sequence Repeats (SSRs) and Single Nucleotide Polymorphisms (SNPs)—to detect DNA-level variations. It provides a standardized, environment-independent genetic profile used to certify seed purity, manage germplasm diversity, and legally enforce Plant Breeders' Rights.
applications:
• Commercial seed certification and agricultural quality assurance boards

• IP protection and legal enforcement for proprietary agricultural breeders

• Commercial nurseries and high-value crop cultivation (e.g., spices, cash crops)

• Global agricultural supply chain traceability and anti-fraud auditing
